description: Start, inspect, rescan, or stop one session-scoped local media-folder monitor. It records bounded file-change signals and never imports media automatically.

allowed_extensions.description: File extensions eligible for proposals; required for start.

approved_workspace_path.description: Absolute approved workspace root; required for start.

recursive.description: Monitor contained subdirectories; defaults to false.

watch_path.description: Absolute contained directory to monitor; required for start.

name: manage_media_watch

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Manage Media Watch
